observations.atomic_claim: `require('eslint-plugin-jest')` returns an object whose `meta.name` is `eslint-plugin-jest`, `meta.version` is a non-empty semver string, `configs` has six entries, `environments.globals` contains `describe`, `it`, and `expect`, and `rules` contains 71 rule modules.
source_facts: - `require('eslint-plugin-jest')` MUST still return a plugin object with `meta.name`, `meta.version`, `configs`, `environments.globals`, and `rules`.

observations.atomic_claim: `Object.keys(require('eslint-plugin-jest').configs)` equals exactly `['all', 'recommended', 'style', 'flat/all', 'flat/recommended', 'flat/style']` in that order.
source_facts: - `configs` MUST continue to expose these six names: `all`, `recommended`, `style`, `flat/all`, `flat/recommended`, and `flat/style`.

observations.atomic_claim: For each of the six names, `Object.keys(plugin.configs[name].rules)` and the rule severities equal the source tables: `all` contains all 71 rules at `error`, `recommended` contains the 19 fixed recommended rules with their source severities, and `style` contains `jest/prefer-to-be`, `jest/prefer-to-contain`, and `jest/prefer-to-have-length` at `error`.
source_facts: - Each same-named configuration MUST keep the rule set it has in the source version.

observations.atomic_claim: `plugin.configs.all.rules` and `plugin.configs['flat/all'].rules` contain no entry whose corresponding rule module has a truthy `meta.deprecated`; in this source inventory that means all 71 non-deprecated rules are present and no deprecated rule is added.
source_facts: - `all` MUST continue to omit deprecated rules.

observations.atomic_claim: `plugin.configs.recommended.rules` deep-equals the source 19-key recommended table and `plugin.configs.style.rules` deep-equals the source three-key style table, including `warn` for `jest/expect-expect`, `jest/no-commented-out-tests`, and `jest/no-disabled-tests`.

observations.atomic_claim: `plugin.configs.recommended.rules` deep-equals `plugin.configs['flat/recommended'].rules`, and linting `test.only('focused', () => { expect(true).toBe(true); });` with either config under ESLint 10.5.0 returns identical message arrays including the same ruleId, severity, line, and column.
source_facts: - `plugin.configs.recommended` and `plugin.configs['flat/recommended']` MUST enable the same rules and produce the same diagnostics.

observations.atomic_claim: With settings `{ jest: { version: 27, globalAliases: { describe: ['context'] }, globalPackage: 'bun:test' } }`, `context('x', () => {})` is still recognized as a describe call, `require('bun:test')` is still recognized as a Jest globals import, and `no-deprecated-functions` still maps `jest.genMockFromModule` to `jest.createMockFromModule` under version 27.
source_facts: - `settings.jest.version`, `settings.jest.globalAliases`, and `settings.jest.globalPackage` MUST keep their user-facing keys and semantics.

observations.atomic_claim: A TypeScript consumer can write `import plugin = require('eslint-plugin-jest'); const n: keyof typeof plugin.configs = 'flat/style'; plugin.rules['no-focused-tests'];` and typecheck; `index.d.ts` still declares `meta`, `environments.globals`, the six config keys, and the rule index signature.
source_facts: - `index.d.ts` MUST keep exporting the plugin object, rule table, and six configurations.

observations.atomic_claim: For `test('x', () => {});` linted with `prefer-importing-jest-globals`, `languageOptions.sourceType: 'module'` reports messageId `preferImportingJestGlobal` with data `jestFunctions: 'test'` and fixes to `import { test } from '@jest/globals';`, while `sourceType: 'script'` fixes to `const { test } = require('@jest/globals');`, with the source message text unchanged.
source_facts: - `prefer-importing-jest-globals` MUST keep its message, import/require choice, and automatic fix results.

observations.atomic_claim: `Object.keys(plugin.configs.all.rules)` deep-equals `Object.keys(plugin.configs['flat/all'].rules)` and equals exactly the 71 `jest/`-prefixed rule names whose modules have no truthy `meta.deprecated`, with no extra or missing keys.

source_facts: - Automatic detection MUST still start from the nearest `node_modules` to the linted file and cache the result.
